Scenario: Bear Steepening with Increased Credit Spreads
Description: A bear steepening of the yield curve alongside rising credit spreads (IG OAS +15bps, HY OAS +45bps) due to inflation concerns and economic slowdown.
Rationale: Expected deterioration in credit quality affecting MBS and corporate assets, leading to higher funding costs.
Assumptions: Inflation expectations rise, impacting consumer confidence and credit quality.

Description: Increased capital and liquidity requirements lead to tighter funding conditions and potential asset reallocation.
Rationale: New regulations could impact liquidity metrics and increase overall funding costs.
Assumptions: Regulatory landscape changes, impacting capital and liquidity strategies.

Description: A geopolitical event causes sovereign credit spreads to widen, impacting funding costs.
Rationale: Increased risk perception affects our Level 1 assets and overall liquidity.
TradeList: Reduce exposure to higher spread assets
Assumptions: Geopolitical tensions escalate, impacting credit markets.

Scenario: Economic Recovery with Falling Credit Spreads
Description: Strong economic recovery leads to falling credit spreads and improved capital ratios.
Rationale: Improved consumer balance sheets enhance liquidity and NII, but may lead to tighter monetary policy.
Assumptions: Economic indicators point towards recovery, improving overall financial health.

Scenario: Stable Rates with Increased Deposit Runoff
Description: Stable interest rates but increased retail deposit beta leads to runoff, straining liquidity.
Rationale: Consumer behavior shifts as clients seek higher yields, impacting funding availability.
Assumptions: Clients are increasingly sensitive to yield, leading to deposit outflows.
